models.name: Gemma 4 E2B
models.memoryBasis: Google's model card: 1,733 MB on the processor and 676 MB on the graphics chip (Galaxy S26 Ultra, 2,048-token context). MySI uses a 16,384-token context and the photo and audio parts, so it allows about 50% more. The extra is an estimate.
models.ramBasis: Minimum from Google AI Edge Gallery's model list (model_allowlists/1_0_23.json, minDeviceMemoryInGb 8). Comfortable size is an estimate.
models.notes: The general build Google benchmarks on Android. Fast enough for most phones with 8 GB of memory or more.

models.name: Gemma 4 E4B
models.memoryBasis: Google's model card: 3,283 MB on the processor and 710 MB on the graphics chip (Galaxy S26 Ultra, 2,048-token context). MySI uses a 16,384-token context and the photo and audio parts, so it allows about 50% more. The extra is an estimate.
models.ramBasis: Minimum from Google AI Edge Gallery's model list (model_allowlists/1_0_23.json, minDeviceMemoryInGb 12). Comfortable size is an estimate.
models.notes: Better answers than E2B, but Google measured its replies at less than half the speed of E2B on the same phone.

models.name: Gemma 4 12B
models.memoryBasis: Google's model card lists computers only, using about 7,300 to 7,900 MB of graphics memory at a 4,096-token context. No phone figure exists; MySI allows about 50% more for its 16,384-token context. Estimate.
models.ramBasis: Estimate. Google publishes no phone figures for this model.
models.notes: Google made this build for computers, not phones. Untested in MySI.

models.name: SmolLM3 3B
models.memoryBasis: Model card: peak 3.12 GB on the processor and 1.22 GB on the graphics chip (Galaxy S26, 1,024-token prompt). MySI allows a little more. Estimate.
models.notes: Text only. Built for a 4,096-token context while MySI asks for 16,384, so it may not load. Untested in MySI.

models.name: Qwen3 0.6B
